coverage.application_semantics: Corpus relations expose stored documentary references, including conditional theorem premises. Use project_graph arguments or query_papers prerequisites for scoped application requirements; do not recompute free assumptions from this flat record pool.
coverage.scope: All records in this captured graph, not all mathematics or merged editions. Paper subgraphs retain recorded argument prerequisites and associated records. Evidence subjects outside a paper remain in the corpus without expanding that paper's argument. Shared membership is not a paper-to-paper proof edge. Direct passages come only from explicit mapping fields; absence does not establish absence from the prose. Paper reading order is separate from mathematical dependency. Node-root traversal and typed witnesses remain available through project_graph and query_papers.

graph.scope: Manually curated, source-grounded intake of two public formal interfaces and a distinct broader manuscript claim. The default selection is the full-support interface. The graph has no extracted Lean dependency edges and supplies no checked proof, semantic certification, or reader acceptance.
graph.title: Zero-temperature SK full support, scalar value, and the separate QAOA manuscript target

coverage.scope: Mapped passages are correspondences, not sentence-level formal support. Section-passage overlaps are document structure, not claim or proof implications. Unmapped text and passages omitted by the selector remain in the validated paper. Graph records outside the selected prerequisite closure remain in the bundle and are not asserted absent. Argument links combine recorded Lean references, curated support, formalization correspondence and explicit assumptions; their SCCs describe only that mixed recorded reachability. Reading order and platform decomposition are separate.
